title: SpecterFakerConfig
description: Configuration schema for Specter Synthetic Persona & Identity Generator (~/.specter/faker/faker.json)

default_nat.description: Default nationality code for persona address, phone, and national ID structures

default_avatar.description: Default avatar generation style ('real' for photography, 'svg' for vector)

default_domain.description: Primary default email domain used when no custom domain or override is supplied

email_domains.description: List of available email domains used for rotation in generated personas

locale.description: Primary identity localization locale (e.g. en_US, vi_VN, ja_JP)

custom_templates_dir.description: Directory storing custom synthetic data generation schemas
